input.quote: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The operative Base Components grant in § 12.1 is expressly "revocable" and runs to "Customer" only (defined as Bluefly, Inc.), with § 14.17 confirming no other licences or rights are granted, so our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf have no coverage and no path to be added. That fails the fallback (affiliates covered) and sits in walk-away territory (revocable at Vendor's discretion with affiliates/contractors excluded). Two elements are already satisfied: § 7.0(c) grants an irrevocable paid-up licence for Type II Materials, and § 14.10 permits assignment of the Agreement to an M&A successor. We therefore delete the at-will revocability, extend the § 12.1 licence to Affiliates and contractors, tie termination to uncured material breach, and add "perpetual" to the paid-up Type II licence.

mappings.element: The licence extends to Customer's affiliates.
The licence extends to contractors acting on Customer's behalf.

mappings.quote: IBM grants Customer an irrevocable, nonexclusive, worldwide, paid-up license to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, and distribute, within Customer's Enterprise only, copies of Type II Materials.

mappings.element: A subscription licence is terminable only for uncured material breach.
The licence is transferable to Customer's successors.
mappings.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.

proposal.summary: Make the Base Components licence extend to Customer's Affiliates and contractors, terminable only for uncured material breach, and confirm the paid-up Type II licence is perpetual.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the at-will revocability in the Base Components licence and extended it to our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, with termination only for our uncured material breach; we also confirmed the paid-up Type II Materials licence is perpetual as well as irrevocable.

ops.text: The foregoing license also extends to Customer's Affiliates and to contractors acting on Customer's behalf, and IBM may terminate it only for Customer's uncured material breach.
